answer: Only a witnessed wharf sighting admits a newcomer. A newcomer locks a $6 bond, then the beacon names one random hour; at that hour they must read the ocean horizon and file a sighting with the hour's beacon code in thirty minutes. Two wharf keepers check the code and the log; a copied sighting, a wrong code, or a missed post burns the bond. One honest newcomer risks $6; faking a hundred needs a hundred sightings at a hundred random hours and $600 locked.
